settings.question: How long does shipping take for KOURTLAB drops?
settings.answer: Orders ship directly from our Curaçao facility and European distribution hubs within 24-48 hours. Caribbean delivery typically arrives within 2-4 business days, while international express takes 3-6 business days.

settings.question: Are KOURTLAB performance apparel pieces true to size?
settings.answer: Yes. All KOURTLAB tees, shorts, and performance layers feature an athletic tailored fit engineered specifically for padel court mobility. If you prefer a relaxed lifestyle fit, we recommend ordering one size up.

settings.question: What is the KOURTLAB 30-day court performance trial policy?
settings.answer: We stand behind every garment we make. If your gear doesn't perform to your standard on court within 30 days, reach out to our team for an effortless exchange or full refund.

settings.question: How can our padel club or academy partner with KOURTLAB?
settings.answer: We collaborate with select padel clubs globally for custom team kit drops, tournament sponsorships, and exclusive club pop-ups. Contact us with subject 'Padel Club Drops' to get started.
